name: Build order
blurb: Finds the rounds a set of packages can be built in, and draws the dependency graph with its longest chain marked.

inputs.label: Packages
inputs.description: One per line, as name: dependency, dependency. A name with no colon has no dependencies.
inputs.default:
app: api-client, ui-kit
admin: api-client, ui-kit, auth
api-client: http, schema
ui-kit: icons
auth: http
http: core
schema: core
icons: core

input.deps:
app: left, right
left: base
right: base

a: b
b: c
c: a
